summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and permission outreach unsent. Four launch-readiness tasks remain open; rights, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and require human-counsel review before any permission request.

Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked/private, and permit only existing read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public/commercial redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy, security, measurement, attribution, owner, privacy, retention, vendor, and incident gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner/consent, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 remains unattributed. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a legal blocker, but site-specific compliance failures and unknown reachability require remediation or evidence before exposure or monetization. No go-live decision is supported; human counsel is required before any Woot permission request, public beta, full launch, affiliate use, or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task may close because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or launch state.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but do block exposure or monetization where a site has failed or unknown consent/privacy/terms checks, unreachable compliance evidence, unresolved rights, unsupported claims, or unverified provenance. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed and do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal lift. Private/gated decisions are concrete: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked/private pending dated owner and reachability evidence.
